Chrager not functioning
Upon investigating, we have found that the root cause of the problem appears to be related to the OCPP (Customer backend) connection, which is currently unstable. This instability could be due to fluctuations in the network signal strength, affecting the charger’s performance.
To improve the situation, we recommend the following steps:
Ensure a stable internet connection
: A stronger, more consistent network signal will help maintain a stable OCPP connection.
Check your router or network infrastructure
: Ensure that there are no interruptions or issues with your local network.
If the issue persists after improving network conditions, please let us know, and we will be happy to further assist you in resolving this matter.
I hope this clarifies the situation. Can we proceed with case closure?
